meta.title: CBSE Grade 6 Mathematics — Final Model Question Paper
meta.subject: Mathematics
instructions: Read each question carefully before answering.
Marks are indicated against each question.

sections.title: Section A – Multiple Choice Questions
sections.instruction: Choose the correct option. Each question carries 1 mark.

questions.question: The absolute value of −15 is:
questions.explanation: The absolute value (or modulus) of a number is its distance from zero on the number line, always non-negative. |−15| = 15.

questions.question: Which of the following is a prime number?
questions.explanation: 97 is only divisible by 1 and itself. 91 = 7 × 13, 87 = 3 × 29, 81 = 3^4. So 97 is prime.

questions.question: The ratio 24 : 36 in its simplest form is:
If 4x − 7 = 13, then x = ?
The LCM of 12, 18, and 24 is:
The sum of all angles of a triangle is:
questions.explanation: The angle sum property of a triangle states that the sum of the three interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

questions.question: The area of a triangle with base 14 cm and height 10 cm is:
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 14 × 10 = 70 sq cm.

questions.question: The median of the data set 3, 7, 2, 9, 5 (arranged in order) is:
questions.explanation: Arranged in ascending order: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9. The middle value (3rd term out of 5) = 5. So median = 5.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct property of a parallelogram?

options.c: Opposite sides are equal and parallel

questions.explanation: In a parallelogram, opposite sides are always equal and parallel. (A square/rectangle are special parallelograms with additional properties.)

questions.question: If 3 pens cost Rs. 36, what is the cost of 7 pens?
questions.explanation: Cost of 1 pen = 36 / 3 = Rs. 12. Cost of 7 pens = 7 × 12 = Rs. 84.

sections.title: Section B – Fill in the Blanks
sections.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct answer. Each question carries 1 mark.

questions.question: The HCF of 36 and 48 is ______.
The integer that is 4 more than −9 is ______.
questions.explanation: −9 + 4 = −5. Moving 4 steps to the right of −9 on the number line gives −5.

questions.question: If a : b = 5 : 8 and b = 40, then a = ______.
The value of the expression 3x + 5 when x = 4 is ______.
A quadrilateral with all four sides equal and all four angles equal to 90° is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A square has all four sides equal (like a rhombus) and all four angles equal to 90° (like a rectangle).

questions.question: The perimeter of a circle is called its ______.
questions.explanation: The perimeter (total boundary length) of a circle is specifically called its circumference, given by C = 2πr.

questions.question: The mode of the data 4, 6, 7, 6, 8, 4, 6, 9 is ______.
questions.explanation: Count each value: 4 appears 2 times, 6 appears 3 times, 7 once, 8 once, 9 once. The most frequent value is 6, so mode = 6.

questions.question: The fraction 5/8 converted to a decimal is ______.
A line that intersects two or more parallel lines is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A transversal is a line that crosses two or more other lines at distinct points. When it crosses parallel lines, it forms several pairs of equal or supplementary angles.

questions.question: If the ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3 : 2 and there are 30 boys, the number of girls is ______.
questions.explanation: Boys : Girls = 3 : 2. Boys = 30 = 3 parts → 1 part = 10. Girls = 2 parts = 2 × 10 = 20.

sections.title: Section C – Short Answer Questions
sections.instruction: Answer the following questions. Each question carries 3 marks. Show your working clearly.

questions.question: Find the HCF of 56 and 84 using the prime factorisation method.
A school has 360 students. The ratio of boys to girls is 7 : 5. Find the number of boys and girls separately.
questions.working:
Total ratio parts = 7 + 5 = 12
Value of 1 part = 360 / 12 = 30
Boys = 7 × 30 = 210
Girls = 5 × 30 = 150
Verification: 210 + 150 = 360 ✓

questions.question: Solve the linear equation: 5x + 8 = 3x + 20.
questions.working:
5x + 8 = 3x + 20
Subtract 3x from both sides: 5x − 3x + 8 = 20
2x + 8 = 20
Subtract 8 from both sides: 2x = 12
Divide both sides by 2: x = 6
Verification: 5(6) + 8 = 30 + 8 = 38; 3(6) + 20 = 18 + 20 = 38 ✓

questions.question: In triangle PQR, angle P = 55° and angle Q = 72°. Find angle R. Also state what type of triangle it is based on its angles.
questions.working:
Sum of angles of a triangle = 180°
Angle P + Angle Q + Angle R = 180°
55° + 72° + Angle R = 180°
127° + Angle R = 180°
Angle R = 180° − 127° = 53°
All three angles (55°, 72°, 53°) are less than 90°, so it is an acute-angled triangle.

questions.question: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides of 10 cm and 14 cm, and a height of 8 cm.
questions.working:
Area of trapezium = (1/2) × (sum of parallel sides) × height
= (1/2) × (10 + 14) × 8
= (1/2) × 24 × 8
= (1/2) × 192
= 96 sq cm

questions.question:
The marks scored by 8 students in a test are: 45, 60, 72, 55, 48, 72, 80, 68. Find:
(a) The mean of the marks.
(b) The mode of the marks.
questions.working:
(a) Mean = Sum of all marks / Number of students
Sum = 45 + 60 + 72 + 55 + 48 + 72 + 80 + 68
= 105 + 127 + 120 + 148
= 500
Mean = 500 / 8 = 62.5

(b) Mode = the value that appears most often.
72 appears 2 times (all others appear once).
Mode = 72

questions.question: Construct a line segment AB = 6.5 cm. Draw its perpendicular bisector using compass and ruler. Describe the steps of construction.
questions.answer: The perpendicular bisector passes through the midpoint of AB at 3.25 cm from each end.
questions.working:
Step 1: Draw a line segment AB of length 6.5 cm.
Step 2: With A as centre and radius more than half of AB (e.g., 4 cm), draw arcs above and below AB.
Step 3: With the same radius and B as centre, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points P (above) and Q (below).
Step 4: Join P and Q. The line PQ is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
Step 5: PQ intersects AB at its midpoint M, where AM = MB = 3.25 cm and angle PMA = 90°.

sections.title: Section D – Long Answer Questions
sections.instruction: Answer the following questions. Each question carries 4 marks. Show all steps clearly.

questions.question:
The following data shows the number of hours 6 students spent studying per week:
Ajay: 12 hours, Bina: 8 hours, Chetan: 15 hours, Deepa: 10 hours, Ekta: 18 hours, Faraz: 11 hours.
(a) Find the mean number of hours.
(b) Find the median number of hours.
(c) If Ekta's hours increase by 6, what will be the new mean?
questions.answer: (a) Mean = 12.33 hours (approx.)   (b) Median = 11.5 hours   (c) New mean = 13.33 hours (approx.)
questions.working:
(a) Mean:
Sum = 12 + 8 + 15 + 10 + 18 + 11 = 74
Mean = 74 / 6 = 12.33 hours (approx.)

(b) Median:
Arrange in ascending order: 8, 10, 11, 12, 15, 18
Number of values = 6 (even)
Median = average of 3rd and 4th values
= (11 + 12) / 2 = 23 / 2 = 11.5 hours

(c) Ekta's new hours = 18 + 6 = 24
New sum = 74 − 18 + 24 = 80
New mean = 80 / 6 = 13.33 hours (approx.)

questions.question:
A rectangular park has a length of 35 m and a breadth of 22 m.
(a) Find the perimeter of the park.
(b) Find the area of the park.
(c) A path of 2 m width runs inside along all four sides. Find the area of the path.
questions.answer: (a) Perimeter = 114 m   (b) Area = 770 sq m   (c) Area of path = 220 sq m
questions.working:
(a) Perimeter = 2 × (l + b) = 2 × (35 + 22) = 2 × 57 = 114 m

(b) Area = l × b = 35 × 22 = 770 sq m

(c) Inner rectangle (after removing the 2 m path on each side):
Inner length = 35 − 2 − 2 = 31 m
Inner breadth = 22 − 2 − 2 = 18 m
Inner area = 31 × 18 = 558 sq m
Area of path = Outer area − Inner area
= 770 − 558 = 212 sq m

Note: Recomputing carefully:
Outer area = 35 × 22 = 770
Inner area = 31 × 18 = 558
Path area = 770 − 558 = 212 sq m

questions.question:
Factorise and simplify:
(a) Write the prime factorisation of 180.
(b) Find three numbers between 1 and 50 that are divisible by both 6 and 9.
(c) Find the LCM and HCF of 45 and 60. Verify: LCM × HCF = product of the two numbers.
questions.working:
(a) Prime factorisation of 180:
180 ÷ 2 = 90
90 ÷ 2 = 45
45 ÷ 3 = 15
15 ÷ 3 = 5
5 ÷ 5 = 1
180 = 2² × 3² × 5

(b) LCM(6, 9) = 18. Multiples of 18 between 1 and 50: 18, 36.
(18, 36 are the two numbers between 1 and 50 divisible by both 6 and 9.)

(c) LCM and HCF of 45 and 60:
45 = 3² × 5
60 = 2² × 3 × 5
HCF = 3 × 5 = 15
LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 = 4 × 9 × 5 = 180

Verification: LCM × HCF = 180 × 15 = 2,700
Product of numbers = 45 × 60 = 2,700 ✓

questions.question:
Rajiv earns Rs. 24,000 per month. He spends 35% on food, 20% on rent, 15% on education, 10% on transport, and saves the rest.
(a) Find the amount spent on each category.
(b) Find the total expenditure.
(c) Find the amount saved.
(d) What percentage of his income does he save?
questions.answer:
(a) Food: Rs. 8,400; Rent: Rs. 4,800; Education: Rs. 3,600; Transport: Rs. 2,400
(b) Total expenditure = Rs. 19,200
(c) Savings = Rs. 4,800
(d) Savings percentage = 20%
